decision.rule: Any exception escaping decide_and_commit, and any FALLBACK_UNCERTAINTY report (returned or attached), permanently marks PRT resource state unverified in-process. Attached reports are evidence only, never bound to the current call. CP1 then refuses further release in that process.

J5_replaced: J5-1: on ANY exception (ordinary or non-Exception BaseException) escaping the S7 decide_and_commit invocation, CP1 first sets the process-level unverified latch, then retains the object (S2), then records evidence. Exceptions from S4 PRT loading (definitions only, PRT not invoked) are CP1_PRT_SOURCE and do not set the latch.
J5-2: on a returned or attached report whose uncertainty equals the pinned FALLBACK_UNCERTAINTY text, CP1 sets the same latch.
J5-3: on a returned result that cannot be detached or fails the shape check, CP1 sets the same latch (replaces the v2 per-entry record "result malformed or not detachable").

J5-4: attached reports are read only via dict.get on the propagated object's base instance dict, bounded-detached and kept as evidence only. They are never release evidence, never bound to the current call, and never clear or prevent the latch.

J5-5: the latch is a constant store (one boolean attribute on the process ledger, set to True) performed BEFORE any allocation-dependent recording, so an allocation failure while recording cannot lose it; a bounded best-effort ledger record follows. The latch is never cleared in-process and is not persisted; a restart loses it together with every outcome (nothing can be accounted after a restart).

J5-6: _Ledger.snapshot reports clean = False whenever the latch is set and names it as a fixed reason string. Every S11/S15 global join therefore fails with CP1_UNRESOLVED_RESOURCES, and every ReservationAccount.release fails with AC_UNRESOLVED_RESOURCES, including outcomes minted RELEASED before the latch was set but not yet accounted (consistent with frozen A07).
